table ip nat {
	chain PREROUTING {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		fib daddr type local counter packets 12 bytes 720 jump DOCKER
	}

	chain DOCKER {
		iifname "br-3f2a9c1d7e10" counter packets 0 bytes 0 return
		iifname != "br-3f2a9c1d7e10" meta l4proto tcp tcp dport 5432 counter packets 3 bytes 180 dnat to 172.18.0.2:5432
		ip daddr 127.0.0.1 iifname != "br-3f2a9c1d7e10" meta l4proto tcp tcp dport 6379 counter packets 0 bytes 0 dnat to 172.18.0.3:6379
		iifname != "br-3f2a9c1d7e10" meta l4proto tcp tcp dport 8443 counter packets 0 bytes 0 dnat to 172.18.0.6:443
	}

	chain POSTROUTING {
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		tcp dport 2222 counter dnat to 10.0.0.9:22
	}
}
table ip filter {
	set allowed {
		type ipv4_addr
		elements = { 10.0.0.1,
			     10.0.0.2 }
	}

	chain DOCKER-USER {
		ip saddr != @allowed tcp dport 5432 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		counter packets 9 bytes 540 return
	}
}
